name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: Boone, Corn, and Maggot go with Perch, Pike, and Foxglen, in some order.
Either Foxglen goes with Boone or someone in the East Watershed goes with Maggot (but not both).
Between Perch and Foxglen, one goes with Corn and the other with Maggot.
Exactly one of the angler at Foxglen, the angler at Stillwater, and the angler fishing with Shrimp belongs to the Sunfish Family.
If at least one of Perch does not go with Mabel, Maggot goes with Mabel, or Bass goes with Esther, then Bass does not go with Nightcrawler.
Exactly two of these are true: Boone goes with Willowmere; Bass goes with Stillwater; Grayreach goes with Maggot.

So Perch does not go with Nightcrawler.
